explanation: The ballot of 5 June 2011 was early and it was about the crisis: the fourth austerity package was voted down in March, José Sócrates resigned, and the country voted six weeks after the request for assistance, under a memorandum the two largest opposition parties had already signed. Probable rather than settled because an early election always has more than one proximate cause — the arithmetic of the minority government returned in 2009 is the other, and the atlas already draws that line to the bailout rather than here.
